title: Results, Figures and Tables: What Did They Find?
objective: Students learn to read data displays and explain results in clear academic English.
phrases: There was no clear difference between ...
The highest value was observed in ...
outcomes: Identify what a graph or table measures.
Describe increase, decrease, trend, peak, and difference.
activity: Figure reader: students answer: What was measured? Which group was highest? What sentence explains the main result?
example: In a bacterial growth graph, the line rises between hour 2 and hour 8, then becomes stable after hour 10.

classroom.title: Writing results from a catalase table
classroom.description: Read simulated class data, use numbers in a comparison, and explain one limit.
